basic_info.description: Gorgeous center-patio home on an idyllic Outer Parkside block. Charm radiates throughout with its beautiful hardwood floors and a myriad of period details. An ornate fireplace provides the living room with a nice refined feel. The tastefully remodeled kitchen is adjacent to the elegant formal dining room. Both bedrooms on the main level are spacious and overlook the deep & inviting backyard. The ground floor features flexible permitted living space and a sharp second bath. Plenty of room for parking and storage is found in the garage. Don't miss your chance to acquire a move-in ready home just a few blocks from Ocean Beach and all the conveniences of Noriega & Taraval. 2118 47th Avenue is the Outer Parkside dream home you've been waiting for!
